title: Impact of Unexpected CEO Departures on Stock Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Event Study. We measure abnormal returns (AR) and cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) around the unexpected CEO departure date (event_day = 0), using the market model to net out market-wide movements.
- Why: Event studies are designed to capture the immediate market reaction to a discrete, time-stamped shock under semi-strong form market efficiency.
- Key assumptions:
  - No confounding firm-specific news within the narrow event window that systematically biases returns.
  - Market efficiency: new information is rapidly incorporated into prices, so effects concentrate around the event.
  - The expected return model is correctly specified over the short window (beta and alpha are stable from pre-period to event window).
  - SUTVA/no spillovers: one firm’s event does not systematically affect others in the sample window.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required packages
suppressWarnings({
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("data.table")
})
library(data.table)

# 1) Read data
path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s54_data.csv"
dt <- fread(path)

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(all(c("stock_id","event_day","ret","mkt_ret","beta") %in% names(dt)))
setkey(dt, stock_id, event_day)

# 2) Estimation window for alpha (pre-event, away from event)
# Use all available pre-event days with event_day <= -3; if none, fall back to event_day < 0.
has_pre3 <- dt[event_day <= -3, .N] > 0
if (has_pre3) {
  pre <- dt[event_day <= -3]
} else {
  pre <- dt[event_day < 0]
}

# Estimate alpha_i as mean(ret - beta*mkt_ret) in pre window for each stock
alpha_tab <- pre[, .(alpha_hat = mean(ret - beta * mkt_ret, na.rm = TRUE)), by = stock_id]

# Merge alpha back; default alpha=0 if no pre data for a stock
dt <- alpha_tab[dt, on = "stock_id"]
dt[is.na(alpha_hat), alpha_hat := 0]

# 3) Compute abnormal returns under different models
# Market model AR (with stock-specific alpha and provided beta)
dt[, AR_mm := ret - (alpha_hat + beta * mkt_ret)]
# Market-adjusted model (assumes beta=1, alpha=0)
dt[, AR_ma := ret - mkt_ret]
# Beta-only (alpha=0) variant of market model
dt[, AR_beta0 := ret - (beta * mkt_ret)]

# Helper: function to compute CAR stats for a given window [a,b] and AR column
car_stats <- function(DT, a, b, ar_col = "AR_mm") {
  # Keep only stocks with complete coverage in the window
  k <- b - a + 1
  sub <- DT[event_day >= a & event_day <= b,
            .(CAR = sum(get(ar_col)), n_days = .N), by = stock_id]
  sub <- sub[n_days == k]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
    return(list(window = c(a,b), N = 0, meanCAR = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  N <- nrow(sub)
  meanCAR <- mean(sub$CAR)
  sdCAR <- sd(sub$CAR)
  se <- sdCAR / sqrt(N)
  tstat <- ifelse(se > 0, meanCAR / se, NA_real_)
  pval <- if (is.na(tstat)) NA_real_ else 2 * pt(-abs(tstat), df = N - 1)
  list(window = c(a,b), N = N, meanCAR = meanCAR, t = tstat, p = pval, CAR_vec = sub$CAR)
}

# Helper: AAR stats by event day for the market model
aar_stats <- function(DT, day, ar_col = "AR_mm") {
  sub <- DT[event_day == day]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(list(day = day, N = 0, AAR = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  N <- nrow(sub)
  AAR <- mean(sub[[ar_col]])
  sdAR <- sd(sub[[ar_col]])
  se <- sdAR / sqrt(N)
  tstat <- ifelse(se > 0, AAR / se, NA_real_)
  pval <- if (is.na(tstat)) NA_real_ else 2 * pt(-abs(tstat), df = N - 1)
  list(day = day, N = N, AAR = AAR, t = tstat, p = pval)
}

# Determine feasible windows based on data support
min_day <- dt[, min(event_day)]
max_day <- dt[, max(event_day)]

# Main event window [-1, +1] if available; otherwise adapt to closest feasible
main_a <- ifelse(min_day <= -1, -1, 0)
main_b <- ifelse(max_day >= 1, 1, 0)

# Compute main results (market model)
main_res <- car_stats(dt, main_a, main_b, "AR_mm")
aar0_res <- aar_stats(dt, 0, "AR_mm")

# Robustness 1: Alternative expected return models over main window
rob_mm_beta0 <- car_stats(dt, main_a, main_b, "AR_beta0")
rob_ma <- car_stats(dt, main_a, main_b, "AR_ma")

# Robustness 2: Alternative event windows (only if supported by data)
alt_windows <- list(
  c(0,0),
  c(0,1),
  c(-3,3)
)
alt_out <- lapply(alt_windows, function(w) {
  a <- max(w[1], min_day)
  b <- min(w[2], max_day)
  if ((b - a + 1) < (w[2] - w[1] + 1)) {
    # not fully supported; skip
    return(list(window = w, N = 0, meanCAR = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  } else {
    car_stats(dt, w[1], w[2], "AR_mm")
  }
})

# Robustness 3: Pre-event placebo window (5 trading days ending at -6 if possible)
if (min_day <= -10 && any(dt$event_day == -6)) {
  plc_a <- -10; plc_b <- -6
} else if (min_day <= -8 && any(dt$event_day == -4)) {
  plc_a <- -8; plc_b <- -4
} else {
  # fallback to the closest 5-day block fully before -3, else 3-day block
  if (min_day <= -7 && any(dt$event_day == -3)) {
    plc_a <- -7; plc_b <- -3
  } else if (min_day <= -5 && any(dt$event_day == -3)) {
    plc_a <- -5; plc_b <- -3
  } else {
    # last resort: 3-day placebo before event, if available
    plc_b <- ifelse(any(dt$event_day == -3), -3, max(dt$event_day[dt$event_day < 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    plc_a <- plc_b - 2
  }
}
placebo_res <- car_stats(dt, plc_a, plc_b, "AR_mm")

# Non-parametric check: Wilcoxon signed-rank on main window CARs (if available)
wilcox_p <- NA_real_
if (!is.null(main_res$CAR_vec)) {
  # Require at least 10 stocks for a meaningful non-param test; else compute if >=5
  if (length(main_res$CAR_vec) >= 5) {
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(main_res$CAR_vec, mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE))
    wilcox_p <- wt$p.value
  }
}

# Pretty printing helper
pfmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", x))
pfmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf("%.3f%%", 100 * x))

cat("Event Study: Unexpected CEO Departures and Stock Returns\n")
cat("-------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("Main window [%d,%d] (Market model):\n", main_a, main_b))
cat(sprintf("  N stocks: %s\n", pfmt(main_res$N)))
cat(sprintf("  Mean CAR: %s\n", pfmt_pct(main_res$meanCAR)))
cat(sprintf("  t-stat: %s, p-value: %s\n\n", pfmt(main_res$t), pfmt(main_res$p)))

cat("Day 0 average abnormal return (AAR):\n")
cat(sprintf("  N obs: %s\n", pfmt(aar0_res$N)))
cat(sprintf("  AAR(0): %s\n", pfmt_pct(aar0_res$AAR)))
cat(sprintf("  t-stat: %s, p-value: %s\n\n", pfmt(aar0_res$t), pfmt(aar0_res$p)))

cat("Robustness checks:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Market model (alpha=0) CAR [%d,%d]: %s (t=%s, p=%s)\n",
            main_a, main_b, pfmt_pct(rob_mm_beta0$meanCAR), pfmt(rob_mm_beta0$t), pfmt(rob_mm_beta0$p)))
cat(sprintf("  Market-adjusted model CAR [%d,%d]: %s (t=%s, p=%s)\n",
            main_a, main_b, pfmt_pct(rob_ma$meanCAR), pfmt(rob_ma$t), pfmt(rob_ma$p)))

for (i in seq_along(alt_windows)) {
  w <- alt_windows[[i]]
  res <- alt_out[[i]]
  cat(sprintf("  Alt window [%d,%d] (Market model): %s (t=%s, p=%s, N=%s)\n",
              w[1], w[2], pfmt_pct(res$meanCAR), pfmt(res$t), pfmt(res$p), pfmt(res$N)))
}

cat(sprintf("\nPlacebo (pre-event) window [%d,%d]: %s (t=%s, p=%s, N=%s)\n",
            plc_a, plc_b, pfmt_pct(placebo_res$meanCAR), pfmt(placebo_res$t), pfmt(placebo_res$p), pfmt(placebo_res$N)))

cat(sprintf("Non-parametric Wilcoxon p-value (main window CARs): %s\n", pfmt(wilcox_p)))
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Negative abnormal returns around the departure, reflecting uncertainty and expected disruption from an unexpected CEO exit.
- Magnitude: AAR at event day near -1% to -2%; CAR over [-1,+1] around -1.5% to -3.0%.
- Rationale: Sudden leadership changes typically increase perceived risk and near-term cash flow uncertainty; prior literature documents negative market reactions to unplanned CEO turnovers, especially when unexpected.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare stock returns before and after the CEO departure event.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The unexpected CEO departure is associated with a positive cumulative abnormal return.
